import numpy as np

from scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation
from scipy.optimize import least_squares
from PIL import Image

class Control:
 def __init__(self,s):
  self.s=s; self.m=s.model; self.d=s.data
  self.ikd=mujoco.MjData(self.m)
  self.sid=self.m.site('robot_pinch_site').id
  self.qi=np.arange(17,24); self.vi=np.arange(15,22)
  self.kd=np.array([30]*4+[15]*3); self.damp=self.m.dof_damping[self.vi]
  self.success=False
 def pose(self): return self.d.site_xpos[self.sid].copy(),self.d.site_xmat[self.sid].reshape(3,3).copy()
 def img(self,name): Image.fromarray(self.s.images(['task_view'])['task_view']).save('/app/output/'+name+'.png')
 def ik(self,p,R=None,q0=None):
  self.ikd.qpos[:]=self.d.qpos
  q0=self.d.qpos[self.qi].copy() if q0 is None else np.array(q0)
  if R is None: R=self.pose()[1]
  def fun(q):
   self.ikd.qpos[self.qi]=q; mujoco.mj_kinematics(self.m,self.ikd)
   pos=self.ikd.site_xpos[self.sid]; rot=self.ikd.site_xmat[self.sid].reshape(3,3)
   return np.r_[pos-p, .3*Rotation.from_matrix(R@rot.T).as_rotvec()]
  low=np.array([-20,-2.23,-20,-2.56,-20,-2.08,-20]); high=-low
  sol=least_squares(fun,np.clip(q0,low,high),bounds=(low,high),max_nfev=100,xtol=1e-9,ftol=1e-9,gtol=1e-9)
  if np.linalg.norm(fun(sol.x))>.005: print('IK err',fun(sol.x),'target',p,flush=True)
  return sol.x
 def step(self,q=None,grip=0,base=None,speed=.7,vel=None):
  a=np.zeros(18); a[10]=grip
  if base is not None: a[:3]=np.clip(np.asarray(base)-self.d.qpos[14:17],-.07,.07)
  if q is not None:
   v=np.clip(3*(q-self.d.qpos[self.qi]),-speed,speed)
   a[11:]=self.d.qvel[self.vi]+self.damp*v/self.kd
  if vel is not None: a[11:]=self.d.qvel[self.vi]+self.damp*np.asarray(vel)/self.kd
  _,success,done=self.s.step(a)
  self.success|=success
  return done
 def move(self,p,R=None,grip=0,n=100,speed=.7):
  q=self.ik(np.array(p),R)
  for i in range(n):
   self.step(q,grip,speed=speed)
   if np.max(np.abs(q-self.d.qpos[self.qi]))<.003 and np.max(np.abs(self.d.qvel[self.vi]))<.01: break
  print('move',self.s.t,'pos',self.pose()[0],'cube',self.d.qpos[:3], 'qerr',np.max(np.abs(q-self.d.qpos[self.qi])),flush=True)
  return q
 def hold(self,q,n=10,grip=1,base=None):
  for i in range(n):
   if self.step(q,grip,base=base):break
 def drive(self,base,q,grip=1,n=200):
  for i in range(n):
   self.step(q,grip,base=base)
   if np.max(abs(np.asarray(base)-self.d.qpos[14:17]))<.001:break
  print('drive',self.s.t,self.d.qpos[14:17],self.d.qpos[:3],flush=True)

start_t=s.t
jp=np.zeros((3,c.m.nv));jr=np.zeros_like(jp)

def trial(vx,vz,nclosed,nopen=3,verbose=False):
 mujoco.mj_setState(c.m,c.d,saved,state_kind);mujoco.mj_forward(c.m,c.d);s.t=start_t;c.success=False
 traj=[]; coords=[]; qhold=c.d.qpos[17:24].copy()
 for i in range(nclosed+nopen+18):
  a=np.zeros(18)
  if i<nclosed+nopen:
   mujoco.mj_jacSite(c.m,c.d,jp,jr,c.sid)
   J=jp[:,15:22]
   v=np.array([vx,0,vz])
   # damped inverse keeps acceleration away from singular directions
   qv=J.T@np.linalg.solve(J@J.T+.005*np.eye(3),v)
   qv=np.clip(qv,-4,4)
   a[11:]=c.d.qvel[15:22]+c.damp*qv/c.kd
   a[10]=1 if i<nclosed else 0
  else:

  _,succ,done=s.step(a);traj.append(a);coords.append(c.d.qpos[:3].copy())

if __name__=='__main__':

 for vx in [2,3,4,5,6]:

    if score<best or succ:
     best=score;print('BEST',best,vx,vz,nc,coords[-1],succ,flush=True)
     np.savez('/app/output/best_trial.npz',actions=np.concatenate([prefix,traj]),params=[vx,vz,nc])
     if succ:
